text:
Ava (Content): Final draft uploaded -> https://docs.internal/launch/launch-blog-final. Can legal + product sign off by 3pm PT? Need CTA mapping and webinar seat confirmation.
Sam (Growth): Small ask  what's the hero line exactly? Draft: '35% faster inference'  need source for claim and an approved parenthetical.
Leo (Product): Source is internal perf suite vs v1 on 8k tokens. Prefer 'up to 35% lower latency (internal benchmark, 8k tokens)'.
Maya (Legal): Agree with Leo. Change absolutes to 'up to' and include the parenthetical. Also remove competitor mention in para 2.
Priya (Design): Hero image needs mobile crop. I'll export 1200x628 + 900x500 and drop into /assets/launch in 8m. Which alt text should I add?
Ava (Content): Alt: 'Redwood inference dashboard and demo stream'. Good to go.
Omar (Ops): Webinar capacity: host supports 600 viewers, we can run 4 demo rooms x 30 seats. Repeat session adds +1 host slot. Ops needs final attendee estimate to confirm.
Nora (CM): HubSpot CTAs ready. Options: 'Save your seat', 'Register for webinar', 'Request a demo'. Recommend mapping demo to sales flow.
Sam (Growth): UTM for hero CTA: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=heroA.
publish-bot: Preview link: https://preview.redwood.com/preview/launch-blog/4543210000  scheduled window: 2026-03-26T15:00:00Z (manual publish).
Ava (Content): Quick one-word ack when you can. Locking in 20m.
Leo (Product): LGTM
Maya (Legal): Legal ok
Sam (Growth): thumbs
Priya (Design): Uploaded ✅
Omar (Ops): Ops confirmed for single run + 4 rooms; repeat pending attendee numbers
Nora (CM): HubSpot flows mapped, CTA variants set
Ava (Content): Thanks team  pushing to publish queue if no more flags.
